changelog.change: Initial corpus source registry: 11 enabled Tamil word sources plus 1 disabled, with the ingest filter and freqBand cuts.
changelog.why: Row 8 - adding a word source must be a data change plus a re-run, never a code rewrite (user directive: the corpus and the daily puzzle are different layers).

sources.name: yen-tamizh_OLD curated Tamil master dictionary
sources.note: The only source carrying category tags. Its blanket 'nouns' tag is dropped by filters.dropCategories - it labels 99.8 percent of entries and so carries no signal; the themed tags (trees, flowers, birds, animals) do.

sources.name: OpenSubtitles 2018 Tamil frequency list (hermitdave/FrequencyWords)
sources.note: The fresh public source. Subtitle Tamil is spoken Tamil, so it is dense in exactly the short everyday words the OLD written corpora are thin on.

sources.name: Aggregated Tamil web and news word frequency
sources.note: 193 MB, and the richest single frequency signal. Largely an aggregate of the per-site lists below, which are kept registered anyway because per-source attestation (a word's 'sources' list) is a quality signal the merged counts cannot carry.

sources.name: Deduplicated Tamil web corpus word frequency
sirukathaigal.com short-story archive word frequency
sources.note: Named .html upstream but the bytes are word,count lines - hence a path-and-mapping decision, not a code one.

sources.name: Tamil Murasu news archive 2011-2020 word frequency
yen-tamizh_OLD raw Tamil word list (t2)
sources.note: Words only, no counts, so it contributes attestation rather than frequency. Its underscore-joined phrases are rejected by the Tamil-only filter.

sources.name: azhiyasudargal.com word frequency
sources.note: DISABLED: the extraction that produced it stripped vowel signs and pulli, so its tokens are bare consonant sequences (nan, yam, tam) that are valid Tamil letters but not Tamil words - some, like a leading 'na', cannot begin a Tamil word at all. Flip enabled to true if a corrected extraction ever replaces the bytes.
